observable: edge width: distance over which radial dL* goes from 10% to 90% of spot contrast
H1_predicts: about 1 to a few melanocyte spacings; does not scale with spot diameter
H2_predicts: about lambda_D; wider on larger dermal patches
falsifies_H1_if: edge width grows with spot diameter across a person's spots, beyond the tool's SDC
falsifies_H2_if: edge width is at the tool's resolution floor on every spot (then H2 needs lambda_D below one cell spacing and becomes indistinguishable from H1)
decision_threshold: threshold set from phantom SDC before any skin photo is analysed

observable: area change of an untreated spot over 6 to 12 months
H1_predicts: no spread from the edge; new white points appear separately
H2_predicts: spot follows its dermal patch; any growth is outward from the edge
falsifies_H1_if: untreated spots grow outward from the edge, beyond SDC, with no new separate points
falsifies_H2_if: untreated spots stay fixed while new separate points appear nearby
decision_threshold: area change beyond the segmentation error from phantoms

observable: where retained pigment sits inside the spot
H2_predicts: graded: more pigment at the rim or away from senescent fibroblasts
falsifies_H1_if: retained pigment is systematically graded by position
falsifies_H2_if: retained pigment is scattered at random
measured_by: photo series (Ben) for a crude score; biopsy for the real map
decision_threshold: pattern statistic defined in the M5 contract

observable: colour of an epidermal-cell transplant at 6 months after the final session
H1_predicts: holds (rho stays near the first post-treatment value)
falsifies_H1_if: epidermal-cell transplant fades beyond SDC by 6 months while nothing new damages the skin
falsifies_H2_if: epidermal-cell transplant holds a match at 6 months or later

observable: graft that brings donor dermis versus epidermal cells alone
H2_predicts: dermis-carrying graft holds; epidermal cells alone fade
falsifies_H1_if: dermis-carrying graft clearly outlasts epidermal cells alone
falsifies_H2_if: both hold, or both fade, equally

observable: p16-positive cells in superficial dermis, spot versus 2 mm outside, same person
falsifies_H1_if: dermal p16-positive cells clearly higher under the spot and melanocyte loss graded with distance from them
falsifies_H2_if: dermal p16-positive cells about equal under the spot and outside
decision_threshold: paired difference; statistic chosen by the partner before unblinding
